blocks.x: Intelligent Process Automation at Scale: the composed architecture, the platforms underneath and the metric the program is judged on.
The problem this solution exists for
RPA estates fragment across kingdoms; agents arrive ungoverned; nobody knows which automation did what; conformance drifts.
Our approach
We mine the process truth first, build the automation spine (events, APIs, RPA, agents under one control plane), stage rollouts with replay evaluation, and keep conformance measured quarterly.
Components

items: Variant mining and automation portfolio scoring
Events, APIs, RPA and agents under one control plane

blocks.x: Platform stack
The solution runs on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Forge: Many agents operating as one governed, measurable workforce. The governed data estate every AI program needs.
How it runs in an engagement

items: Baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
Gated pilot on bounded scope with the testable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.
Staged rollout on the platform stack with SLOs, replay evidence and operator enablement.
Challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.

items: Reference architecture adapted to your estate, with the integration contracts itemized.
The composed capability live on bounded scope, with audit evidence produced automatically.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness

The readiness checklist covers three items: source-system access under your security policy, an operating team willing to trial the new workflow, and agreement on the baseline measurement method before work starts.
Proof

items: Real-time fraud decisioning on instant rails: 38% lower fraud losses at a higher approval rate
KYC refresh backlog cleared: 70% faster cycles with agentic file assembly

blocks.x: Industry fit

Deployed across Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Telecom, Media & Entertainment, Public Sector & Government, Logistics & Supply Chain. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
Outcomes we commit to
How a delivery runs

This capability runs on the cadence set out below; the rhythm is fixed, the scope is signed. Weeks 1–2 measure and sign the baseline with your team; nothing builds against an unsigned number. Weeks 3–8 prove the pattern on deliberately bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — under a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, closing with a measured delta against the baseline. Every gate is pass, stop or redirect, in writing.

items: The signed measurement of where the metric stands today, with the method written out so the number can be defended to finance.

A running record of the delta against baseline, updated at every gate, reviewed at every steering meeting.
